## Summary by CodeRabbit

- New Features
  - None.

- Refactor
  - Aligned IPC peer info version field order with the spec; no functional impact expected.

- Tests

- Chores
  - Docker image now runs the application as a non-root user to enhance security.
  - Pinned native module dependency to an exact version for more reproducible builds.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Walkthrough
Introduces a non-root Docker user and runs build steps as that user. Reorders PeerInfo fields in IPC fuzz v1 (jamVersion before appVersion) and updates its codec and tests accordingly. Pins @typeberry/native dependency to an exact version in two package.json files.

## Changes
| Cohort / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **Containerization**<br>`Dockerfile` | Adds non-root user `typeberry`, sets ownership of `/app`, switches to `USER typeberry`, and runs npm steps and entrypoint under that user. |
| **IPC Fuzz v1: PeerInfo field order**<br>`extensions/ipc/fuzz/v1/types.ts`, `extensions/ipc/fuzz/v1/types.test.ts` | Swaps PeerInfo constructor/field order to jamVersion before appVersion; updates Codec mapping and create helper; adjusts test data/comments to match. |
| **Dependency pinning**<br>`packages/core/crypto/package.json`, `packages/core/erasure-coding/package.json` | Pins `@typeberry/native` from `0.0.1-43eee4f` to `=0.0.1-43eee4f` in both packages. |

## Sequence Diagram(s)
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  participant Test as Test (fuzz v1)
  participant Peer as PeerInfo
  participant Codec as PeerInfo.Codec
  participant Bin as Binary

  Test->>Peer: new PeerInfo(fuzzVersion, features, jamVersion, appVersion, name)
  Peer->>Codec: encode()
  rect rgba(200,230,255,0.3)
    note over Codec: Field order changed
    Codec->>Bin: write(fuzzVersion, features, jamVersion, appVersion, name)
  end
  Bin-->>Codec: bytes
  Codec-->>Test: encoded bytes

  Test->>Codec: decode(bytes)
  rect rgba(200,230,255,0.3)
    Codec->>Bin: read(... in same order ...)
  end
  Codec-->>Test: PeerInfo(jamVersion, appVersion)
```
